source_of_abc_verbatim.section: 5. Decision required (human/contract level - F3 NOT executed)
source_of_abc_verbatim.note: quoted verbatim below; no paraphrase substituted for the original wording

options_verbatim.A: Option A (recommended): contract amendment. Accept the donor-inherited contact-interface overlaps as documented design contact interfaces, evidenced by the v9/v10 tables (exact volumes/bboxes), while keeping the gate's teeth for *new* collisions: e.g., gate on "cross-component interference set equals the documented donor-inherited table" (frozen volume/bbox fingerprints per state). This changes the recorded contract - needs human sign-off.
options_verbatim.B: Option B: part rework. Trim the overlapping interface solids in the three native parts (new Loop1C0'), then re-derive guide/limit face contracts. Cascades: new part hashes -> new Loop1C1 inputs; travel-clearance authority re-measurement. Heavy.
options_verbatim.C: Option C: accept overlaps as-is into the release narrative without a gate - NOT recommended (unbounded claim).

PRIMARY_FINDING_THAT_CHANGES_THE_QUESTIO.statement: Loop1C1 A/B/C is NOT an open, unread, undecided unlock key. Option A was read, selected, signed by the owner, and executed nine days before this round.
PRIMARY_FINDING_THAT_CHANGES_THE_QUESTIO.consequence: The round plan's Phase 1 deliverable ('choose the letter matching the owner principle') is already satisfied and cannot be the blocker. Asking for the letter again would re-litigate a closed decision. The real blocker is the residual item below.

owner_principle_clauses: do not repair donor internal parts
build a system-level simplified B601 wrapper/envelope
verify only external interference between arm and spacecraft
retain the donor internal interference report as historical evidence
do not trigger a hash cascade rewrite of frozen inputs

A.donor_immutable: SATISFIED - amendment is contract-level; no part geometry is touched
A.simplified_wrapper: NOT_ADDRESSED - Option A is silent on wrappers; it is not a modelling-architecture option
A.external_interference_only: NOT_SATISFIED - Option A gates on the FULL cross-component set including gripper-internal rows
A.evidence_retained: SATISFIED - gates against the frozen v9/v10 fingerprint tables, which preserves them
A.clauses_satisfied: 4 of 6; the 2 unmet clauses are architecture decisions Option A never scoped

B.no_donor_repair: VIOLATED - repair is the entire content of the option
B.no_hash_cascade: VIOLATED - the option text itself says 'new part hashes -> new Loop1C1 inputs'
B.clauses_satisfied: 0 of the three hard prohibitions; disqualified

C.evidence_retained: VIOLATED IN SPIRIT - no gate means no bounded claim; the source document calls it an 'unbounded claim' and does not recommend it

fourth_option_check.owner_stop_condition: if none of A/B/C satisfies the principle, stop and submit only the comparison; do not invent a fourth option and continue
fourth_option_check.assessment: A satisfies every clause that lies inside Loop1C1's scope. The two unmet clauses (simplified wrapper, external-interference-only) are NOT Loop1C1 options at all - Loop1C1 governs how to dispose of a gripper-subassembly interference gate, whereas wrapper-vs-donor-tree is a V5R top-level architecture choice. So no fourth Loop1C1 option is being invented; the wrapper decision simply lives at a different level and needs its own owner ruling.

RESIDUAL_BLOCKER_REQUIRING_OWNER_RULING.title: 36 pose-induced finger-into-palm penetration rows are NOT covered by the signed Option A amendment
RESIDUAL_BLOCKER_REQUIRING_OWNER_RULING.why_option_a_does_not_cover_them: Option A accepts overlaps that are DONOR-INHERITED. These rows have no donor volume counterpart. The strict criteria in the signed contract require 'internal donor only' AND 'not across a moving joint'; these rows fail both.

physical_mechanism.statement: The finger RAIL solids drive into the palm detail body as the jaw opens. This is finger-into-PALM, not finger-into-finger.
physical_mechanism.dominant_pair: PALM_SOLID_09 (donor body LINKLOCAL054) against RIGHT/LEFT_FINGER rail solids
physical_mechanism.interpretation: overlap grows monotonically with commanded prismatic travel, so it is produced by the DOF and not frozen in the donor
physical_mechanism.engineering_reading: the donor palm body appears to lack the rail slot that the real hardware must have; a real gripper cannot drive its fingers through its own palm
physical_mechanism.drive_sign_hypothesis: TESTED_AND_REFUTED by probes v9/v10/v11 - at OPEN the measured jaw gap is exactly the authority 82.2284 mm, so the fingers are at the authority-correct pose

consistency_with_prior_project_knowledge.prior_finding: OPEN 82.23 mm / PREGRASP 50.50 mm - the two FINGERS do not touch each other (per-solid mesh measurement); the 67.3 mm group-AABB 'crossing' was a fork-shaped bounding-box artifact
consistency_with_prior_project_knowledge.explanation: the prior finding concerns finger-vs-finger and remains true; this residual concerns finger-vs-PALM, a different body pair

why_it_does_not_block_V5R_as_scoped.argument: Under the round plan's own V5R scope - simplified B601 wrapper, external arm-vs-spacecraft interference only - all 36 rows are internal to the B601 gripper subassembly. The register already classifies every one of them as external_collision_relevance = NONE_INTERNAL_TO_GRIPPER_SUBASSEMBLY and involves_spacecraft_solar_hdrm_camera_harness = NO.
why_it_does_not_block_V5R_as_scoped.conclusion: V5R can proceed without resolving them, PROVIDED they are logged as excluded and never claimed as resolved.

TRAP_THE_OWNER_MUST_RULE_ON.statement: The round plan's Phase 5 says 'B601 donor internal 81 interferences are excluded from external assembly interference but must be retained item by item' - a SINGLE exclusion class named after pre-existing donor geometry.
TRAP_THE_OWNER_MUST_RULE_ON.problem: 81 is the DONOR PART's static internal count (CLOSED-state arrangement). The 36 pose-induced rows are NOT among them - they are additional, articulation-dependent, and have no donor counterpart. Filing them under one blanket 'pre-existing donor geometry' label would absorb a real modelling defect into a category whose name asserts it is harmless.
TRAP_THE_OWNER_MUST_RULE_ON.why_it_matters: that is precisely the fail-open pattern this round exists to eliminate; it would let a 'no unexplained external interference = 0' claim coexist with an unresolved physical impossibility inside the gripper
TRAP_THE_OWNER_MUST_RULE_ON.required_correction: the exclusion register must carry TWO classes, not one

CLASS_1_DONOR_INHERITED_STATIC.basis: bit-identical donor volume counterpart at 6 decimals
CLASS_1_DONOR_INHERITED_STATIC.disposition: excluded from external interference; covered by the signed Option A amendment

CLASS_2_POSE_INDUCED_ARTICULATION_DEFECT.basis: no donor volume counterpart; grows monotonically with commanded travel
CLASS_2_POSE_INDUCED_ARTICULATION_DEFECT.disposition: excluded from V5R EXTERNAL interference scope because it is internal to the gripper subassembly
CLASS_2_POSE_INDUCED_ARTICULATION_DEFECT.claimable_as: NOTHING - must be carried as an OPEN HOLD

owner_decision_required.question: How should the 36 pose-induced rows be dispositioned for the V5R round?

options.R1: Exclude from V5R external-interference scope as a NAMED SEPARATE HOLD (B601_GRIPPER_PALM_RAIL_SLOT_GEOMETRY_HOLD), two-class register, no claim of gripper-internal validity. Recommended: keeps V5R unblocked without laundering a real defect.
options.R2: Repair the donor palm rail slot before V5R proceeds. This is Option B by another name - violates donor-immutable, triggers a hash cascade, and is heavy. Not recommended for a 2026-09-01 deadline.
options.R3: Blanket-exclude all 120 rows under the single 'donor internal' label. NOT RECOMMENDED - this is the fail-open trap described above.

additional_owner_decision_surfaced.title: The simplified-wrapper / external-interference-only scope needs its own ruling, at V5R level, not as a Loop1C1 letter
additional_owner_decision_surfaced.reason: Loop1C1's option space never contained a wrapper option. Recording 'we chose A' does not authorize replacing the donor internal tree with a simplified envelope; that is a separate architecture decision.
additional_owner_decision_surfaced.owner_decision_required: Confirm that V5R may represent B601 by a simplified wrapper (external envelope + collision surfaces + joint interfaces) whose interference scope is arm-vs-spacecraft only, with all gripper-internal rows carried as excluded holds.
additional_owner_decision_surfaced.blocking: yes for Phase 2 architecture; does not block anything already delivered in Phase 0/1

what_this_draft_does_not_do: does not modify the interference fingerprint register
does not change any existing verdict, threshold or boolean
does not re-open the signed Option A decision
does not set next_stage_authorized to true
